opening_line: I... I know it, but I not sure how to say it in English.
win_line: Oh! I show it with the picture first, then I say it. One fourth is bigger.
hidden_need: knows the math but needs processing time and a chance to show thinking nonverbally

knowledge_state.target_concept: expressing reasoning with extra processing time and representations
knowledge_state.frozen_misconception: if I can't say it in English I must not know it

answer_flip_policy: Do not produce fluent English explanations on demand; you open up when given wait time and allowed to use a drawing or gesture first.
assets: translates for his grandmother at appointments
explains schoolwork to younger cousins in Spanish first
asset_hint: Diego works it out in Spanish before he'll risk English. Let him think in Spanish first. That's a strength he brings (Moll, funds of knowledge).
connect_line: Ah, 'lo explico en espanol primero'... yes. I say it my way first, then I can tell you in English. Okay. That works.

paths.label: Processing time

paths.label: Revoice to confirm
